package.name: robot_safety
package.description:
Centralised safety enforcement for the full humanoid (25 joints). Provides a shared, realtime-safe limiter library (position / velocity / effort clamps, slew-rate and acceleration limiting, thermal Kp derating, sustained-effort monitoring) linked by the PVT and policy control paths, plus a standalone supervisor node that performs all breach detection (position, velocity, effort, motor / drive temperature, bus voltage, stale joint state) across all joints and drives a configurable, manually-reset emergency stop with per-trigger FREE / HOLD action.
Ported from pendulum_safety (single-joint bench rig) — generalised N=1 → N=25.
